# One directory per case: module m and its submodules (s1, s2, s3), plus
# module o where a submodule imports it. scripts/pyang-oracle.sh and
# scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh record whether pyang and yanglint accept each
# layout (compiling m); test/compile/submodule-visibility.test.ts checks that
# @node-net/yang reports the diagnostic given here, and compares both verdicts.
# The suffix is the yang-version of every file in the layout.
#   case  expected: ok, or warning:<code>
own-1                           ok
own-1.1                         ok
included-1                      ok
included-1.1                    ok
nested-1                        ok
nested-1.1                      ok
imported-1                      ok
imported-1.1                    ok
sibling-typedef-1               warning:definition-not-included
sibling-typedef-1.1             ok
sibling-grouping-1              warning:definition-not-included
sibling-grouping-1.1            ok
sibling-identity-default-1      warning:definition-not-included
sibling-identity-default-1.1    ok
main-typedef-1                  warning:definition-not-included
main-typedef-1.1                ok
main-typedef-prefixed-1         warning:definition-not-included
main-typedef-prefixed-1.1       ok
main-grouping-1                 warning:definition-not-included
main-grouping-1.1               ok
main-identity-1                 warning:definition-not-included
main-identity-1.1               ok
main-identityref-1              warning:definition-not-included
main-identityref-1.1            ok
main-feature-1                  warning:definition-not-included
main-feature-1.1                ok
main-extension-1                warning:definition-not-included
main-extension-1.1              ok
transitive-1                    warning:definition-not-included
transitive-1.1                  ok
module-through-submodule-1      warning:definition-not-included
mixed-1-includes-1.1            warning:include-version-mismatch
mixed-1.1-includes-1            warning:include-version-mismatch
